decisions.reason: After another year on the market, this close-to-core sensor module likely performs at or near aspiration, and its modest resource demands fit a growing firm with slack.
Its strong fit with the firm's established industrial input architecture suggests results are at least near aspiration, so retention is the default choice.

As a more solution-oriented kit with higher support intensity, it remains vulnerable if sales lag the firm's rising aspirations, but platform complementarity and available slack still favor keeping it for now.

This recent module is still in the learning phase, and because it extends the existing platform with limited additional commitment, management would usually allow more time unless performance clearly falls short of aspiration.

The remote-access service is strategically aligned with the firm's push into wallboxes, load management and energy management, so even mixed early results would not yet justify redeploying the resources.
